signup.title: Create your PROJEXA account
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it, then come back and log in.

hero.subhead: PROJEXA replaces the scattered spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and missed follow-ups that quietly cost construction and interior design projects time and money — with one AI Copilot-backed system for schedule, site, and spend.
hero.note: No credit card required. Set up your first project in minutes.

problem.heading: The work isn't the expensive part. The coordination is.
problem.subhead: Every mid-size construction and interior design team loses money the same way — not on materials or labour, but on the gaps between them.

commsScattered.title: Communication scattered everywhere
commsScattered.body: RFIs in email, submittals in WhatsApp, approvals over calls. By the time an answer surfaces, the site has already moved on.

deadlinesSlip.title: Deadlines slip silently
deadlinesSlip.body: Schedule delays get discovered after they've already cascaded into the next trade, the next milestone, the next client conversation.

noSourceOfTruth.title: No single source of truth
noSourceOfTruth.body: Budgets in one spreadsheet, change orders in another, site diaries on paper. Nobody — including the PM — has the full picture.

rework.title: Rework from miscommunication
rework.body: A decision made on-site never makes it back to the drawings. Three weeks later, it's redone at the client's expense — and yours.

solution.heading: Every module talks to every other module.
solution.subhead: Not twenty disconnected tools stitched together with exports — one system where a change order updates the budget, and a schedule slip shows up in the diary automatically.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: One live timeline the whole team works from — so a slip on-site shows up before it becomes a missed milestone.

scope.title: Scope of Work (BOQ)
scope.body: Line-item scope tied straight to budgets and progress, not a spreadsheet nobody re-checks.

workProgress.title: Work Progress
workProgress.body: Actual site progress against plan, tracked continuously instead of reconstructed at month-end.

siteDiary.title: Site Diary
siteDiary.body: The daily record of what actually happened on site — searchable, not buried in a paper logbook.

rfisSubmittals.title: RFIs & Submittals
rfisSubmittals.body: Every question and every approval tracked to resolution, with nothing left waiting in someone's inbox.

punchList.title: Punch List
punchList.body: Snags and closeout items owned, assigned, and closed — visible to everyone, not just whoever wrote it down.

changeOrders.title: Change Orders
changeOrders.body: Scope changes documented and priced the moment they happen, not reconstructed in a dispute later.

budgets.title: Budgets & Expenses
budgets.body: Real spend against real budget, per project — visible before it becomes a surprise at handover.

aiCopilot.title: AI Copilot
aiCopilot.body: Grounded in your own project data — ask it about any RFI, budget line, or schedule change and get a real answer.

copilot.heading: An AI Copilot that actually knows your project.
copilot.subhead: This isn't a chatbot bolted onto a dashboard. PROJEXA's AI Copilot is wired into every module — schedule, RFIs, site diary, budgets, change orders — so it can answer real questions about a real project, in context, the moment you ask.

grounded.title: Grounded in your project, not the internet
grounded.body: Every answer is drawn from your own schedule, RFIs, site diaries and budgets — not a generic model guessing.

ask.title: Ask instead of digging
ask.body: What's blocking the electrical RFI on the third floor? gets answered in seconds, not after three phone calls.

workflow.title: Built into the workflow
workflow.body: The Copilot sits alongside every module, so it already has the context — no exporting data or switching tabs.

chat.q1: What's blocking the electrical RFI on Level 3?
chat.a1: RFI-042 has been pending vendor response for 4 days. It's blocking two dependent schedule items due Friday. Want me to flag it to the vendor and notify the PM?

roi.heading: Built to save teams at least 2x what they spend on it.
roi.body: We won't hand you a fabricated statistic — every project is different. What we will say plainly: the cost of PROJEXA is small next to the cost of a missed deadline, a disputed change order, or a week of rework caused by a decision that never made it back to the drawings. Prevent one of those on a single project, and PROJEXA has already paid for itself many times over.
roi.boxTitle: The math is simple, not fabricated.
roi.boxBody: PROJEXA costs a small, predictable amount per month. A single missed deadline, rework cycle, or vendor dispute typically costs far more than that — on just one project. Catch it before it happens, and you're ahead.

deadline.title: One missed deadline costs more than a year of PROJEXA
deadline.body: A single schedule slip that cascades into the next trade, or a change order that goes undocumented, routinely costs more than what a team spends on PROJEXA in a full year.

rework.title: Rework is the silent budget killer
rework.body: Miscommunication between site and office doesn't show up as a line item — it shows up as redone work, disputed change orders, and client trust you have to rebuild.

compound.title: Coordination, done once, compounds
compound.body: Every project run through PROJEXA makes the next one faster — the same schedule discipline, the same paper trail, the same AI Copilot context, reused.

finalCta.heading: PROJEXA makes work complete.
finalCta.body: Every RFI answered. Every schedule slip caught early. Every change order on record. From first drawing to final handover — nothing falls through.
